headline: Last session: Sensex gains 308 points while Nifty reclaims the 23,000 mark

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Tuesday, 3 November.

why: FPIs turned net buyers towards the end of October despite pulling out ₹34,843 crore during the month.
Domestic passenger vehicle dispatches crossed the five-lakh units mark in October on strong festive demand.
Eicher Motors registered a 7% increase in October sales with exports jumping 47%.
Nifty 50 and Sensex rebounded in the previous trading session, driven by positive market sentiment.
whatHappening: Markets are closed today, November 1, 2026, on account of the weekend.
On the last trading day (October 30), Sensex gained 308 points and Nifty 50 rose 116.35 points.
Eicher Motors reported strong monthly sales growth for October 2026.
ONGC invited applications for 3,047 apprentice vacancies open until November 20.
summary: The Indian stock market is closed today, November 1, 2026, due to the weekend. In the previous trading session on October 30, the benchmark indices closed higher with Sensex gaining 308 points and Nifty reclaiming 23,000. October auto dispatches showed strong festive growth, and FPIs turned net buyers towards the month's end.
